metadata.description: Personal pinned marketplace: every plugin here was source-reviewed and copied at a recorded commit (see README.md).

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Read-only live dashboard pane (scasella/claude-flightdeck) pinned at 6150b9f

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Transcript skins (hellosverre/claude-skins) pinned at e6ca8ea, update check + star toast patched out

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: File tree pane with git status (data-goblin/claude-code-filetree) pinned at 44d4a62

plugins.name: aurora-bridge
plugins.description: First-party right-hand pane: heartbeat, per-call activity timeline, permission gate, subagents, hot files, last-turn receipt, in your own palette

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Themeable reply rendering (NahumLitvin/prismantis) pinned at v0.25.1 0d93494

plugins.name: firstmate-calm
plugins.description: Firstmate Calm sailboat spinner + conversation-only transcript (kunchenguid/firstmate fm) forked at d20196a for the rice

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context window as a stacked bar above the prompt (hamzafer/claude-code-mods) pinned at 77f1ebc, palette + one-row line style patched in

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: 5h/7d usage bars and session cost above the prompt (hamzafer/claude-code-mods) pinned at 77f1ebc, palette + shared row patched in

plugins.name: mindful-breath
plugins.description: Guided breathing above the prompt while Claude works (halluton/Mindful-Claude) pinned at 411c9c4, palette glow + band height patched in

plugins.name: cctop
plugins.description: btop-style session dashboard in a side pane (tomstagl/cctop) pinned at 6ceafc3, plugin only (no companion binary)

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Instrument panel pane: context, limits, cost, agents, tools, files, tests, risky-command guard (drkokorev/cockpit-for-claude) pinned at 8960ed8

plugins.name: paneline
plugins.description: Tabbed side pane: Activity, Files, Agents, Context, MCP, Skills, Spend (markneonin/paneline) pinned at fd20c8c

plugins.name: secret-box
plugins.description: Claude uses secrets without seeing them (ray-amjad/claude-code-mods, plugins/secret-box) pinned at 6db48a3: masked box to .env, placeholders in and out, .env never committed
